# National Education Association (NEA)

> The NEA represents over 3 million educators advocating for public education, educator rights, student success, and systemic educational equity across the United States.

The NEA is the largest labor union and professional organization for educators in the United States. The site serves as a comprehensive hub for educator resources, advocacy campaigns, professional development, and member engagement on education policy and social justice issues.

## Key Topics

- Public Education
- Educator Rights
- Student Success
- Professional Development
- Education Advocacy
- Public Schools
- Teacher Quality
- Education Policy
- Educator Support
- Family Engagement
- School Health & Safety
- Standardized Testing Reform
- Educator Recruitment & Retention
- NEA Membership
- Education Equity

## Core Advocacy & Mission

- [National Education Association | NEA](https://www.nea.org): NEA homepage: 3M+ educators united for public education and social justice
- [About NEA | NEA](https://www.nea.org/about-nea): NEA organizational overview, mission, leadership, and governance
- [Advocating for Change | NEA](https://www.nea.org/advocating-for-change): NEA advocacy campaigns for education funding and systemic change
- [Take Action | NEA](https://www.nea.org/advocating-for-change/action-center/take-action): Action center for member engagement on education policy advocacy
- [Home - Education Votes](https://educationvotes.nea.org): NEA political advocacy platform for voter mobilization on education

## Educator Support & Workplace Rights

- [Your Rights & Workplace | NEA](https://www.nea.org/your-rights-workplace): Educator rights, fair pay, benefits, and workplace equity advocacy hub
- [Professional Excellence | NEA](https://www.nea.org/professional-excellence): Professional development and leadership resources for educators
- [Teacher Quality | NEA](https://www.nea.org/student-success/teacher-quality): Professional development programs and resources for educator excellence
- [Recruit and Retain Educators | NEA](https://www.nea.org/student-success/recruit-and-retain-educators): Strategies to address teacher shortages and improve educator retention

## Student Success & Educational Quality

- [Student Success | NEA](https://www.nea.org/student-success): NEA's student success initiative ensuring quality resources for all students
- [Great Public Schools | NEA](https://www.nea.org/great-public-schools): NEA framework for equitable, well-resourced public schools nationwide
- [School Health & Safety | NEA](https://www.nea.org/healthy-schools): NEA initiatives for safe, healthy school environments and wellness
- [Standardized Testing & Student Assessment | NEA](https://www.nea.org/student-success/standardized-testing-student-assessment): NEA position on assessment reform and equitable student evaluation
- [Engaged Families & Communities | NEA](https://www.nea.org/engaged-families-communities): Resources for parent and community engagement in student learning

## Membership & Movement

- [Join Our Movement | NEA](https://www.nea.org/join-our-movement): NEA membership and movement participation call-to-action page
- [NEA Affiliates | NEA](https://www.nea.org/nea-affiliates): Locator for state and local NEA affiliate organizations nationwide

## Resources & Information

- [Resource Library | NEA](https://www.nea.org/resource-library): Comprehensive library of NEA resources, guides, and educational materials
- [Media Center | NEA](https://www.nea.org/media-center): NEA news, press releases, and media resources on education policy
- [NEA Today | NEA](https://www.nea.org/nea-today): NEA magazine and news covering education issues and member stories

## Optional
